objective: Take the dependabot github-actions bump, and stop one contract test from pinning the digest of the action it only uses to identify a step's owner.
decision_supported: Should a test that asserts which job owns the artifact upload also pin the action's commit sha? No: the sha is the dependency, and pinning it in the test makes every bump edit an unrelated assertion.
acceptance: Every action reference keeps a commit sha rather than a floating tag.
The required-check ownership contract still passes.
The marker no longer has to change when the action is bumped.
stop_conditions: A workflow would reference an action by tag rather than sha.
risks_and_fallbacks: Dropping the sha from the marker could mask a workflow that pins a tag; a separate check already enforces sha pinning.
Fallback: keep the sha in the marker and update it with each bump.
